# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Lazzaretto Vecchio (1423 Venice Santa Maria di Nazareth Plague Isolation Island)
oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio = {
	audio_tier = 2
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = clergy_medical_employment
	category = infrastructure_category

	rural_settlement = no
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	expensive = yes
	build_time = generic_town_build_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	country_potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}
	location_potential = {
		is_coastal = yes
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			has_building = building_type:lazaretto
			development >= 25
			AND = {
				current_year >= 1423
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = VEN
						tag = GEN
						tag = BYZ
						tag = ROM
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				location = { has_owner = yes }
			}
			location.owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis_vecchio_built value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_variable = oe_dis_nuovo_built
							any_owned_location = {
								has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
							}
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_double_lazaretto_built value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio_maint = {
			icon_type = building_type
			icon = oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
			medicaments = 0.08
			fiber_crops = 0.12
			incense = 0.06
			books = 0.04
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		local_disease_resistance = 0.20
		local_oe_dis_levantine_plague_impact_modifier = -0.35
		local_bubonic_plague_impact_modifier = -0.25
		local_life_expectancy = 3
	}
}

# 2. Lazzaretto Nuovo (1468 Venice Tezoni 40-Day Cargo Fumigation & Healthy Crew Quarantine Island)
# Uses domestic `local_merchant_capacity` for trade capacity without breaking domestic building rules.
oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo = {
	audio_tier = 2
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = clergy_medical_employment
	category = infrastructure_category

	rural_settlement = no
	town = no
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	expensive = yes
	build_time = generic_town_build_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	country_potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}
	location_potential = {
		is_coastal = yes
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
			owner ?= {
				has_advance = oe_dis_adv_sanita_quarantine
			}
		}
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				location = { has_owner = yes }
			}
			location.owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis_nuovo_built value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_variable = oe_dis_vecchio_built
							any_owned_location = {
								has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
							}
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_double_lazaretto_built value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo_maint = {
			icon_type = building_type
			icon = oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
			medicaments = 0.10
			incense = 0.12
			lumber = 0.10
			books = 0.06
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		local_disease_resistance = 0.25
		local_oe_dis_levantine_plague_impact_modifier = -0.45
		local_oe_dis_levantine_plague_resistance_modifier = 0.35
		local_merchant_capacity = 0.25
		local_trade_center_power = 0.05
	}
}

# 3. Kontumaz Pestkordon Frontier Station (1710-1770 Habsburg Military Frontier Sanitary Cordon)
oe_dis_pestkordon_station = {
	audio_tier = 2
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = coastal_fort_employment
	category = defense_category

	rural_settlement = no
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	country_potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}
	location_potential = {
		OR = {
			development >= 18
			num_roads >= 1
		}
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1580
			owner ?= {
				has_advance = oe_dis_adv_sanita_quarantine
			}
		}
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				location = { has_owner = yes }
			}
			location.owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis_pestkordon_built value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_dis_pestkordon_station_maint = {
			icon_type = building_type
			icon = oe_dis_pestkordon_station
			medicaments = 0.06
			incense = 0.08
			tools = 0.05
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		local_disease_resistance = 0.20
		local_oe_dis_camp_fever_impact_modifier = -0.45
		local_typhus_impact_modifier = -0.30
		local_oe_dis_camp_fever_resistance_modifier = 0.30
	}
}
